candidates.description: The field was laser‑leveled during the summer/fall of 2005.
Compost was applied at a rate of 17 Mg ha⁻¹ (turkey manure and wine‑grape residue).
Beds were prepared with a spacing of 1.52 m from furrow to furrow.
A mustard (Brassica nigra) cover crop was planted on 3 Nov 2005 with three planting lines per bed.
The mustard cover crop was mowed on 26 Apr 2006.
Mustard residue was lightly incorporated into the top 10 cm of soil about 19 days after mowing, with sprinkler irrigation in between.
Mechanical weeding/cultivation was performed during the tomato growing season.
Manual weeding was also carried out during the tomato growing season.
A sulfur application was made as a mite‑ and disease‑preventive measure.
Furrow irrigations were applied at roughly 11‑day intervals, totaling nine irrigations (≈88 ± 22 mm each).
5760 tomato seedlings were manually transplanted on 18–19 May 2006.
